title: Buildings With an Ocean View
summary: Given an array of building heights, identify and return the indices of buildings that have an unobstructed view of the ocean to the right, ensuring no taller buildings are to their right.
statement: Given an array of building heights, identify and return the indices of buildings that have an unobstructed view of the ocean to the right, ensuring no taller buildings are to their right. The indices should be listed in ascending order.
constraints: Building heights are distinct; the ocean is to the right.
A building has a view only if every building to its right is shorter; return qualifying indices in increasing order.
hints: Scanning from the ocean side maintains the tallest blocker seen so far.
A building qualifies exactly when its height exceeds that right-side maximum.
Scan right to left, append qualifying indices, update the maximum, then reverse the result.
The maintained maximum summarizes every building to the right, making the comparison both necessary and sufficient.
editorial: The maintained maximum summarizes every building to the right, making the comparison both necessary and sufficient.

tests.explanation: Indices zero, two, and three are taller than everything to their right.
Every building has an unobstructed ocean view.
